summary:
The Tenacity refactor was explicitly stopped until next sprint. The current priority is the nightly reconciliation refund double-counting bug in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; no investigation or fix for that issue has occurred yet.

Invoice PDF work proceeded while exploring related failures. `render_invoice()` previously discarded negative line items because `_format_lines()` skipped all amounts `<= 0`. This was changed to skip only zero amounts, and a regression test confirmed a credit appears immediately after its related invoice item. `_format_lines()` now uses the shared locale-aware `format_money()` helper, with tests covering positive, negative, and zero values. Pagination was also corrected: point-to-inch conversion is centralized in `_row_height()`, and repeated table-header space reservation is now calculated once. Tests confirmed an 86-item invoice fits on two pages rather than three. Results:

- Focused negative-line test: passed in `0.31s`.
- Money-format tests: `3 passed in 0.18s`
- PDF suite: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`
- Billing suite: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`
- Ruff found no issues; existing golden PDFs remained byte-stable.
- Diff: four files, `217 insertions(+), 184 deletions(-)`; `git diff --check` was clean. Visual review of three generated PDFs remains useful.

A search for legacy database session factories found three in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`; this work has not yet started.

S3 decommissioning is partially complete. `old-media-17` is in `us-east-1`; versioning was suspended, and version `v-9f2c1a` of `photos/2017/logo.png` was deleted. Inventory/copy/dry-run verification was previously completed, but DNS/version cleanup and bucket deletion remain.

For sandbox payments, use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is retired and serves stale fixtures.

Critical constraints remain: paste exact test output rather than paraphrasing; never edit `api/openapi.yaml` without first posting the proposed diff in `#ledgerly-api` and tagging `@dana-api`; do not edit `tests/conftest.py` without approval from `@mira` in `#ledgerly-tests`.
